using namespace std;

class FastScanner {
public:
    BufferedReader br;
    StringTokenizer st;

    FastScanner() : br(stdin), st("") {}

    string next() {
        while (!st.hasMoreElements()) {
            try {
                string line;
                getline(cin, line);
                st = StringTokenizer(line);
            } catch (...) {
                // ignore
            }
        }
        return st.nextToken();
    }

    int Int() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long Long() {
        return stoll(next());
    }

    string Str() {
        return next();
    }
};

class StringTokenizer {
private:
    vector<string> tokens;
    size_t pos;

public:
    StringTokenizer(const string& s) : pos(0) {
        istringstream iss(s);
        string token;
        while (iss >> token) {
            tokens.push_back(token);
        }
    }

    bool hasMoreElements() {
        return pos < tokens.size();
    }

    string nextToken() {
        if (hasMoreElements()) {
            return tokens[pos++];
        }
        return "";
    }
};

class Solution {
public:
    PrintWriter* out;
    int INF = INT_MAX;
    int NINF = INT_MIN;
    int MOD = 998244353;
    int mod = 1000000007;
    FastScanner* fs;

    Solution(PrintWriter* out, FastScanner* fs) : out(out), fs(fs) {}

    void solution(int all, int testcase) {
        int n = fs->Int();
        mod = fs->Int();

        vector<vector<long long>> dp(n, vector<long long>(n * n + 5, 0));
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dp[0].size(); j++) {
                for (int cnt = 0; cnt <= i; cnt++) {
                    if (j - cnt >= 0) {
                        dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - cnt];
                        dp[i][j] %= mod;
                        if (dp[i][j] == 0) {
                            dp[i][j] += mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> sums(dp.size(), vector<long long>(dp[0].size(), 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < dp.size(); i++) {
            int sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < dp[0].size(); j++) {
                sum += dp[i][j];
                sum %= mod;
                if (sum == 0) sum += mod;
                sums[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }

        vector<long long> fact(501 * 501, 0);
        fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < fact.size(); i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i;
            fact[i] %= mod;
        }

        vector<vector<long long>> ncr(501, vector<long long>(501, 0));
        ncr[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < ncr.size(); i++) {
            ncr[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < ncr[0].size(); j++) {
                ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i - 1][j] + ncr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
                if (ncr[i][j] == 0) ncr[i][j] += mod;
            }
        }

        long long res = 0;
        for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            int cnt = n - i;
            int pre = n - cnt;
            long long com = (ncr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod;
            if (com == 0) com += mod;
            long long sum = 0;

            for (int dif = 1; dif < cnt; dif++) {
                for (int inv = dif; inv < dp[0].size(); inv++) {
                    if (dp[cnt - 2][inv] == 0) {
                        break;
                    }
                    if (inv - dif - 1 < 0) continue;
                    long long x = dp[cnt - 2][inv];
                    long long y = sums[cnt - 2][inv - dif - 1];
                    x *= y;
                    x %= mod;
                    if (x == 0) x += mod;
                    sum += x * (cnt - dif);
                    sum %= mod;
                }
            }
            res += sum * com;
            res %= mod;
            if (res == 0) res += mod;
        }

        *out << res % mod << endl;
    }
};

class PrintWriter {
private:
    ostream* out;

public:
    PrintWriter(ostream* os) : out(os) {}

    void println(long long val) {
        *out << val << endl;
    }

    void println(int val) {
        *out << val << endl;
    }

    void println(string s) {
        *out << s << endl;
    }

    void print(long long val) {
        *out << val;
    }

    void print(int val) {
        *out << val;
    }

    void print(string s) {
        *out << s;
    }

    void flush() {
        out->flush();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    FastScanner fs;
    PrintWriter out(&cout);

    int T = 1;
    for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
        Solution sol1(&out, &fs);
        sol1.solution(T, t);
    }
    out.flush();

    return 0;
}
